notes.title: [DreamHack Dallas] When The River Runs Dry - Developer Playthrough
notes.content: A pre-recorded stream for the DreamHack Dallas event.

notes.title: EARTH APPRECIATION EVENT - PLAYTHROUGH
notes.content: We've got some super good bug fixes and updates to the graphics in this release. Watch our devs play through the new demo, and make sure to wishlist our game if you like what you see! :)

notes.title: **WOMEN's DAY EVENT** When The River Runs Dry Stream!
notes.content:
We're streaming non-stop from March 7th-March 11th as part of the Women's Day Sale! We're super excited to be part of such a cool event with lots of women developers making all genres of games!

We'll be running a pre-recorded stream for most of the event with an hour-long video, showing ourselves playing When The River Runs Dry and talking about our experiences developing and producing the game. 

But if you want to tune in live and ask questions, here's when we will be streaming for our Q&A and live demo:
Monday, March 7th at 5pm EST/2pm PST
Wednesday, March 9th at 3pm EST/12pm PST

notes.title: **THE BIG ADVENTURE EVENT** When The River Runs Dry (Pre-recorded - Part ONE)
notes.content:
We are livestreaming for the FIRST time as part of The BIG ADVENTURE EVENT!

We will be livestreaming our demo of When The River Runs Dry and discussing its development and features, to give y'all a first look into our game and how it was made!

Tune in January 22nd, 2PM-EDT/11AM-PDT to watch our featured stream!

And visit the event page on Steam from January 20th-24th here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/thebigadventureevent]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/thebigadventureevent[/url]!
